method: Actual generated JS/WASM and synchronous Ym2413 wrapper/AudioEngine with optional native state support. Exact mono stereo PCM, explicit post-scenario PCM probes, rate/read/status/IRQ hooks, held resampler timing and public reset/replay. Actual VgmPlayer seek rebuilds from zero; no register-derived snapshot, tolerance, mock, Mixer or device.

legacy.frameCountScope: All raw/public chip and Engine output frames in bounded positive self-checks. Native source frames produced internally by Engine resampling are reported separately and not double-counted.

sdk.frameCountScope: All raw/public chip and Engine output frames in bounded positive self-checks. Native source frames produced internally by Engine resampling are reported separately and not double-counted.

legacy.frameCountScope: Actual Engine processFrames calls include parser render-ahead queues during baseline, reset/replay and all silent seek prefixes. Delivered/requested player frames include the seek-discarded prefix and are a separate view, not added again to generated frame totals.

sdk.frameCountScope: Actual Engine processFrames calls include parser render-ahead queues during baseline, reset/replay and all silent seek prefixes. Delivered/requested player frames include the seek-discarded prefix and are a separate view, not added again to generated frame totals.

limits: Native PCM runs at floor(clock/72). The wrapper sums melody and percussion mono outputs to both sides. Engine cases test averaging/holding at separate output rates, without optional Sega PSG.

Only the two native state exports may extend the ABI; existing PCM behavior, public reset/replay and VgmPlayer seek replay remain exact. Native checkpoint continuation has separate tests; serialized state bytes are not compared between builds.

Raw reset preserves existing free-running counters and pending address; public reset recreates the native handle and reapplies the JS mute mask. Both existing paths are exercised without changing them.
OPLL read/status compatibility APIs return zero and IRQ remains false; real hook notifications are compared at synchronous API/chunk boundaries.
VgmPlayer seeks use the existing replay-from-zero helper. Actual rendered Engine frames include prefetch queues and are counted separately from delivered/discarded player frames.
No browser, Worklet scheduling, Native backend, physical hardware, Mixer or listening judgement is tested.
frameCountScope: Both builds: main complete body renders plus explicit257-frame post-scenario probes, including selected public reset/replays. Bounded wrapper positives and actual VgmPlayer Engine render-ahead/seek-prefix frames are separate components of totalGeneratedOutputStereoFrames. Engine internal native source frames and player delivered frames are not added twice.
